airplane.title: Network monitor
airplane.badge.hint: No network: open the network monitor
airplane.state.on: Airplane mode is on since {time}: nothing leaves this device.
airplane.state.off: Airplane mode is off. Every network attempt the app makes is listed here as it happens.
airplane.confirmOff.title: Turn airplane mode off?
airplane.confirmOff.body: The page reloads: the browser cannot lift the block from a page that is already open. Save your work first if it isn't saved yet.
airplane.toast.on: Airplane mode is on: nothing leaves this device.
airplane.test.hint: Tries to reach example.com, so you can watch it appear here (blocked while airplane mode is on).
airplane.certificate.hint: A file with the time span, every attempt in it, and exactly what it counts (attempts, not bytes; requests in flight when the switch went on count too), with its SHA-256.
airplane.certificate.unsigned: Not signed yet: the certificate carries its SHA-256 only.
airplane.limits: Loopback (a local model on this computer) stays allowed. The app's own files load from the cache only; a script chunk that isn't cached would load from the app's server, and is then counted as reaching the network.
airplane.runner.paused: Paused while airplane mode is on: code run here could reach other sites. Turn airplane mode off to run it.
